item.title: All the Wrong Reasons Why Google Finance Changed Its Design
item.description: On July 23, Google Finance left beta and the “Switch to classic Google Finance” link disappeared. If you’ve opened a ticker page since then, you’ve seen the result: the AI-powered redesign, tested in the US since August 2025 and global since April, is now the only Google Finance there is. Google Finance has been my default quick-check for years — it’s a big part of how I invest from Taiwan. So I’ve been following this redesign closely (disclosure at the bottom).
